frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole organism with hammer-shaped broad muzzle and dense filtering dentition, not skull-only or generic marine reptile.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: IVPP V20291 dorsal skull and V20292 ventral skull, actual photos/interpretations Fig1–2 in Li et al.2016. Body follows paper postcranial description; living surface and pose inferred, not copied paleoart.

scale.basis: Approximate genus-sized artistic target from indexed IVPP/CAS author news; direct news page timed out, not a measured V20291 length. Primary skull photos carry2cm bars.

uncertainties: Colour, soft tissue, webbing and detailed limb/tail profile are reconstruction choices.
Dentition count deliberately reduced for lowpoly readability, not claimed exact count.
2014 downturned zipper-mouth reconstruction is superseded by2016 hammerhead evidence; do not copy it.
